_comment: Hands-on audit of state/system-level consortium boards (Oct 2026). Per-school link-out pages for TX (TCCTA job bank), MS (MCCB), WI (WTCS), MT (MUS), WV (HEPC/CTCS), ME (MCCS) and OK (OSRHE) were compared against the registry: every campus they list is either already 'ok' or points at the same generic campus HTML page the registry already has (classify() finds no ATS), so no per-unitid entries were needed. True aggregators (SUNY, SBCTC, NCCCS, CommunityCollegeJobs.com) got their own fetcher modules instead and are seeded via registry.AGGREGATORS.

Louisiana Community and Technical Colleg.notes: careers.lctcs.edu is a new system-wide PageUp (Nuxt front end) board: 266 open jobs across BRCC, BPCC, CLTCC, Delgado, Fletcher, LDCC, SOWELA, SLCC and the system office (143 part-time faculty). Read by the pageup fetcher's nuxt flavour; adds to (does not replace) the governmentjobs.com/careers/louisiana config.
